routing.note: Quote (/v1/slice) and project (/v1/project) route through the same rule so a quoted part and its delivered project land on the same printer. Printer choice is internal to the workshop; the website never shows it to customers.

ender3_generic_235.label: Ender 3 generic / 0.4 mm (temporary)
ender3_generic_235.note: Real future workshop printer. Present but disabled: its profile is OrcaSlicer's bundled generic Creality Ender-3 preset with only the envelope overridden and is not calibrated. The service refuses to start if a printer is enabled without calibrated=true, so this profile can never produce a live quote or project until the owner supplies a calibrated profile set and flips both flags. Confirm the real Z height (235 vs 250 mm) before enabling.
